data.name: Etheline
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Aethelflaedh which means 'noble, famous noblewoman'. This name was borne by a 10th-century Anglo-Saxon queen and is derived from the Old English elements ea-thael 'noble' and flaedh 'bright, famous'. It is also associated with the Greek goddess Aethelia, the goddess of eternal flowers.
